test_inputs.explanation: The agent navigated to URLs on the Docker Magento admin at http://dockerized-magento.local and operated on order_id 204 (seen in the /order_id/204/ paths). The execution log does not show any specific per-item ids or input values, so items_json is provided as an empty array to avoid changing item quantities. Other optional numeric fields were left blank and the defaults for do_offline and update_qty were set to true; admin_form_id uses the default 'edit_form'. These values reflect the actual URLs and order id observed in the execution summary.
